_meta.note: Throughput summary per crosspath for the leak check. a = [[attack range, damage, bloon-hits/s with 1,2,4,8,16,32 bloons in range]], m / c = damage per second to one MOAB-class / Ceramic, r = range (units; a Red moves 25 units/s). Own attacks plus permanent sub-towers; no abilities, no buffs from other towers. Data (c) Ninja Kiwi.
notes: Decoding: tools/game/extract_towers.py (game v56 export). Only the tower's own attacks count: abilities, Sun Temple / True Sun God sacrifice add-ons, Corvus spells, submerged-only attacks, Necromancer graveyard attacks, Silas' ice shards on Ice Monkeys and Adora's Sun God transformation are left out; "passive" damage (Sub Pre-emptive Strike, Druid Spirit of the Forest) is counted.

Rate: projectiles/s = emission count x burst count / cooldown. A weapon with FireWhenAlternateWeaponIsReadyModel (rate 0.05 placeholder, every Monkey Buccaneer) fires once per shot of its partner, so it uses the partner's cooldown.

Alternate shots (AlternateProjectileModel, every k-th shot: Flash Bomb, Bomb Shooter, Quincy...) replace 1 in k shots. BonusProjectileAfterInterval (Gwendolin) adds 1 every k shots. Swap weapons (Rosalia) count projectile A only.

Damage per hit = DamageModel damage; vs one MOAB / Ceramic add every DamageModifierForTagModel whose tag list (often several tags, e.g. "Moabs,Ceramic") matches the bloon (MOAB = Moab+Moabs, Ceramic = Ceramic). A DamageModel of 0 with a MOAB bonus (M.A.D. +450) is MOAB-only damage. BloonTagDamageOverride sets the damage vs that bloon; DamageModifierForBloonType adds damage vs a bloon id (Ceramic, Moab). Damage >= 1e6 (instant kills: Druid vines) is left out of m and c.
Ring damage (DamageInRingRadiusModel: Mortar The Big One shockwave) counts like an explosion with that damage and the projectile radius.

Crowd model (unchanged from 0.9): with n bloons spread over 2R of track, a projectile reaches 1 + (n-1) x min(1, cover/2R), cover = max(2 x radius, 0.7 x travel distance); seeking and bouncing projectiles and zones the size of the range, or anything that sits on the track 3 s or more, reach all n. Hits per projectile = min(pierce, reach x rehits), rehits = lifespan / ClearHitBloons interval, capped at 20.

Spread shots (Arc / RandomArc / Random emission with n projectiles over arc degrees): only 1 + (n-1)(1 - arc/30) of them (at least 1) can reach one bloon; each extra bloon in range lets one more projectile find a target, so the share that hits is (one + (n-one) x min(1, (N-1)/(n-1)))/n with N bloons. 8 tacks over 360 degrees: 1 of 8 hit a lone bloon, all 8 with 8 bloons. Seeking projectiles (Ace Flying Fortress radial darts) all reach the target whatever the spread. Estimate.

State bonuses (DamageModifierForBloonState) count when the same weapon applies that state: Laser Shock (+damage vs shocked), Flash Bomb stun (+4 for shuriken vs stunned), freeze bonuses. Estimate: assumes the target always carries the state.

Sub-projectiles: on-contact / on-damage / pierce-used children spawn once per bloon the parent hits; on-exhaust / on-expire once per parent projectile; on-interval every interval of the parent's lifespan. A spread of fragments (n > 1 over 90 degrees or more) never hits the bloon that spawned it: it adds nothing at 1 bloon and needs a second bloon - unless each fragment explodes within its own blast radius of where it was made (Bomb cluster bombs), then every one of them hits the first bloon too.

DoT refreshes, it does not stack: a bloon carrying it takes damage / interval per second. Bloons holding it at once = min(bloons in range, applications/s x duration); each tick is a hit of that damage. Vs one MOAB / Ceramic: damage / interval per DoT kind (not per hit). Estimate: bloons that leave the range keep burning, bloons that pop early waste ticks.

Psi: PsiEffectModel is a DoT (damagePerTick every tickRate up to maxDuration); PsiLimitProjectileModel (how many bloons Psi holds at once) is not in the export, so the cap is applications/s x maxDuration. Estimate.

Filters: FilterOutTag / FilterWithTag(inclusive=true) drop a tag, FilterWithTag(inclusive=false) keeps only it, FilterMoabModel flip=false keeps only MOAB-class and flip=true drops them. Attacks that drop MOAB-class get m = 0; attacks that keep only MOAB-class get no stream row.

Sub-towers (permanent only) are added to the parent's entry: Engineer sentries at min(max, lifespan / spawn interval) x per spawn (typed Sentry Expert/Champion sentries: one of the 4 types per spawn, so each type at 1/4), Aircraft Carrier planes (up to 3), Wizard Lord Phoenix's permanent Phoenix, Corvus' Spirit, Beast Handler pets, Etienne drones, Comanche reinforcements at count x duration / cooldown. Each sub-tower attack keeps its own range (global ones use 9999). Ability-made towers (Marines, Lord Phoenix, Drone Swarm, UCAV, Sacrificial Totem, Ball of Light, Sun Avatars) are excluded.

Beast Handler pets use their base-power stats (BeastHandlerPetModel dmgRange/pierceRange scale them with merged power in code; not modelled). Gyrfalcon line: GyrfalconPatternModel swoop (initialDamage, pierce = grabAmount, radius = grabRadius 45, every cooldown) and grapple damage on the held target (every grappleDamageRate, in m only). Great White / Orca / Megalodon: thrash explosions (CreateGreatWhiteEffectModel); the grab-and-drown itself is code and not counted. Estimate.
Zone immunity bypass (Striker Jones L5/L19 Black, Silas White): changes what pops, not the numbers here; the pop model decides that.

Not modelled: buffs from other towers (the engine applies Village / Alchemist itself), crits, ability uptime, targeting priority, exact placement, MOAB-class children and Ice freezing (the engine handles those).
